entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery inner %s is evaluated per anchor and requires a query evaluation time (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: subqueryGridCtx reports no grid only when no evaluation anchor was threaded through, which the HTTP handlers never do: every wire query lowers through LowerAt, LowerAtRange or LowerAtRangeOpts, and only the bare Lower entry point used by package tests leaves the anchor unset
